tools.name: papers_search
tools.description: Scholarly paper search (150M+ works) ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Search Crossref metadata for journal articles, preprints, books, conference papers and datasets: title, authors, year, venue, DOI, citation count, licence and full-text links. Filters: year range, type; sort by relevance,

tools.name: papers_doi
tools.description: Paper metadata by DOI ($0.001 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Full Crossref record for a DOI: title, all authors with ORCID and affiliations, dates, venue, citation and reference counts, funders, licences, full-text links, relations (preprint/version/retraction updates). HTTP POST https://mpp-rese

tools.name: drugs_label
tools.description: FDA drug label (indications, warnings, dosage) ($0.003 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Official FDA structured product label for a drug by brand or generic name: indications, boxed warning, contraindications, warnings, dosage, adverse reactions, interactions, active ingredients, manufacturer, rout

tools.name: drugs_adverse_events
tools.description: FDA adverse event reports for a drug (FAERS) ($0.003 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Counts from FDA Adverse Event Reporting System for a drug: total reports, serious share, top reported reactions, outcomes, reports by year. Signals only; reports do not prove causation. HTTP POST https://mpp-resea

tools.name: recalls_search
tools.description: FDA recalls search (food, drugs, devices) ($0.003 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Search FDA enforcement reports (recalls) for food, drugs or medical devices by text, firm, status and class, newest first: product, reason, class, firm, distribution, dates, recall number. HTTP POST https://mpp-resea

tools.name: trials_search
tools.description: Clinical trials search (ClinicalTrials.gov) ($0.003 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Search 500k+ registered clinical studies by condition, intervention, sponsor or free text, filter by status and phase: NCT id, title, status, phases, dates, sponsor, conditions, interventions, enrollment, countries

tools.name: trials_study
tools.description: Clinical trial details by NCT id ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). One study in depth: design, arms, eligibility criteria, primary and secondary outcomes, sites, contacts, sponsor and collaborators, status dates, whether results are posted. HTTP POST https://mpp-research.fmf-x402.workers.dev

tools.name: company_lei
tools.description: Legal entity lookup (GLEIF LEI) ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Find legal entities by name or LEI in the global LEI index (2.9M+ entities): legal name, jurisdiction, legal and HQ addresses, legal form, registry id, status, renewal, BIC, and direct and ultimate parents when looking up one

findings.detail: Description of "papers_search" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: papers_search, recalls_search, trials_search · Private data: papers_doi, trials_study · Public sink: papers_search, papers_doi, drugs_label, drugs_adverse_events, recalls_search, trials_search, trials_study, company_lei.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: papers_search, recalls_search, trials_search · Private data: papers_doi, trials_study · Public sink: papers_search, papers_doi, drugs_label, drugs_adverse_events, recalls_search, trials_search, trials_study, company_lei

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
